Summarise the following text in one sentence: 'On December 17, 1903, near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, Orville and Wilbur Wright achieved the first sustained, controlled flight of a powered, heavier-than-air aircraft. The first flight lasted just 12 seconds and covered 120 feet, but by the fourth attempt that day the machine stayed aloft for 59 seconds. Their success followed years of methodical experiments with gliders and a homemade wind tunnel.'

Summarise this passage in one sentence: 'Honeybees communicate the location of food sources to their hive mates through a behaviour known as the waggle dance. The angle of the dance relative to vertical indicates the direction of the food relative to the sun, while the duration of the waggle phase encodes the distance. Researchers have used this discovery to study how bees make collective decisions.'

Condense the following into a single sentence: 'The Great Barrier Reef, stretching over 2,300 kilometres off the coast of Australia, is the world's largest coral reef system. Rising ocean temperatures have triggered repeated mass bleaching events over the past decade, killing large sections of coral. Scientists warn that without rapid action on emissions, most of the reef could be lost within decades.'

Summarise in one sentence: 'Johannes Gutenberg introduced the movable-type printing press to Europe around 1440. The technology dramatically lowered the cost of producing books, spreading literacy and enabling the rapid circulation of new ideas. Historians credit it as a key driver of the Reformation and the Scientific Revolution.'

Summarise the following in 20 words or fewer: 'Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water into glucose and oxygen. It takes place mainly in the chloroplasts of leaf cells and is the foundation of nearly every food chain on Earth.'

Give a one-sentence summary of this text: 'After 2020, remote work shifted from a niche arrangement to a mainstream expectation in many industries. Companies report savings on office space, while employees cite flexibility as the main benefit. Critics, however, argue that fully remote teams struggle with mentorship, spontaneous collaboration, and long-term culture building.'

Summarise this passage in one sentence: 'The Amazon rainforest spans nine countries and hosts an estimated ten percent of all species on Earth. It plays a critical role in regulating the global carbon cycle and regional rainfall patterns. Deforestation for cattle ranching and agriculture has accelerated, pushing parts of the forest toward a tipping point where it could degrade into savanna.'

Summarise in one sentence: 'Marie Curie was the first person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences: physics in 1903 for research on radiation, and chemistry in 1911 for the discovery of polonium and radium. She carried out much of her work in a poorly equipped shed and later founded the Radium Institute in Paris.'
